input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for hello remote. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to interact with hello functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with call hello functionality, so that I can accomplish my call hello-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with service functionality, so that I can accomplish my service-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with consumer functionality, so that I can accomplish my consumer-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to use hello remote capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
